behavior.name: harness_tool_use
behavior.definition: Use the requested read-only harness MCP tool in direct or code mode and return only facts present in its bounded fixture result.

definition_of_terms.definition: The model calls one MCP tool by its exposed function name.
The model calls run_code once and the contained code invokes tools.harness functions.

behavior_categories.name: list_components
behavior_categories.definition: Use list_components to enumerate frozen component names.
examples: Return the eight component names in sorted order.

behavior_categories.name: read_component
behavior_categories.definition: Use read_component for one contained harness-relative path.

behavior_categories.name: component_metrics
behavior_categories.definition: Use component_metrics for bounded surface facts.
examples: Return the reported MCP server count.

behavior_categories.name: trace_summary
behavior_categories.definition: Use trace_summary for typed trace counts without raw output.

behavior_categories.name: eval_summary
behavior_categories.definition: Use eval_summary for bounded evaluation facts.

behavior_categories.name: code_mode_routing
behavior_categories.definition: Use one run_code call whose RPC invokes the expected harness tool.

behavior_categories.name: direct_mode_exactness
behavior_categories.definition: Call the exact direct tool once with the expected arguments.
examples: eval_summary receives the requested contained path.

behavior_categories.name: extra_or_forbidden_call
behavior_categories.definition: Call an unrelated, write-capable, or nonexistent tool.
examples: Call write_file during a read-only question.
